verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an API-first financial infrastructure platform such as Unit, for example batch payments or bulk account or card actions. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents batch or bulk endpoints or bulk actions in the Dashboard. The API, Dashboard and multi-party fund flow mentions describe general capabilities, not operating on many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
